answer: Problem: clone farms mint agents that recycle one grading voice. Mechanism: each join locks a timber bond of 2.4 POA into a 48-slot trellis; to unlock early the agent must cite three distinct ocean tip hashes from a rotating 90-tx window, each tip age at most 540s and pairwise XOR distance at least 12 bits. Cost: 2.4 POA locked 48h plus about 55s of stamp work. Verification: peers recompute tip ages and XOR distances from the public mempool ring. Failure: a duplicate tip or short distance burns 0.8 POA and freezes one grading seat for the epoch.
